elements.requirement: A special resolution of the members or of a class of members of a company is defined as a resolution passed by a majority of not less than 75%.
elements.quote: A special resolution of the members (or of a class of members) of a company means a resolution passed by a majority of not less than 75%

elements.requirement: A written resolution is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by members representing not less than 75% of the total voting rights of eligible members.
elements.quote: A written resolution is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by members representing not less than 75% of the total voting rights of eligible members

elements.requirement: A resolution of a private company passed as a written resolution is not a special resolution unless the resolution stated that it was proposed as a special resolution.
elements.quote: the resolution is not a special resolution unless it stated that it was proposed as a special resolution

elements.requirement: A resolution of a private company passed as a written resolution may only be passed as a special resolution if the resolution stated that it was proposed as a special resolution.
elements.quote: if the resolution so stated, it may only be passed as a special resolution

elements.requirement: A resolution passed at a meeting on a show of hands is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by not less than 75% of the votes cast by those entitled to vote.
elements.quote: A resolution passed at a meeting on a show of hands is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by not less than 75% of the votes cast by those entitled to vote

elements.requirement: A resolution passed on a poll taken at a meeting is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by members representing not less than 75% of the total voting rights of the members who, being entitled to do so, vote in person, by proxy or in advance on the resolution.
elements.quote: A resolution passed on a poll taken at a meeting is passed by a majority of not less than 75% if it is passed by members representing not less than 75% of the total voting rights of the members who (being entitled to do so) vote in person, by proxy or in advance

elements.requirement: A resolution passed at a meeting is not a special resolution unless the notice of the meeting included the text of the resolution and specified the intention to propose the resolution as a special resolution.
elements.quote: the resolution is not a special resolution unless the notice of the meeting included the text of the resolution and specified the intention to propose the resolution as a special resolution

elements.requirement: A resolution passed at a meeting may only be passed as a special resolution if the notice of the meeting specified the intention to propose the resolution as a special resolution.
elements.quote: if the notice of the meeting so specified, the resolution may only be passed as a special resolution

thresholds.what: Minimum majority required to pass a special resolution of members or of a class of members
Minimum percentage of total voting rights of eligible members required to pass a written resolution by the requisite majority
thresholds.quote: not less than 75% of the total voting rights of eligible members

thresholds.what: Minimum percentage of votes cast by those entitled to vote required to pass a resolution on a show of hands by the requisite majority
thresholds.quote: not less than 75% of the votes cast by those entitled to vote

thresholds.what: Minimum percentage of total voting rights of entitled members voting in person, by proxy or in advance required to pass a resolution on a poll by the requisite majority
thresholds.quote: not less than 75% of the total voting rights of the members who (being entitled to do so) vote
